event_pipeline.summary: Three fire-and-forget server emitters POST ~55 event names + dynamic trial_* families to env-configured CLOSE_WEBHOOK_URL(_<LABEL>). No retry/queue/dead-letter anywhere - all downstream loss is consistent with that. External pipeline writes imai_events, then fans out. Event SET unchanged since df73c535 (no events added or removed by the 25 commits); the documented created_list event does NOT exist in the repo (R16 unmerged).

invariants_for_next_agent: NEVER push to InfluencerMarketing-Ai/Discovery-imai from data-work sessions (standing user rule). All docs/analysis live in caras-new-voices/imai-data-work.

NEVER build dollar analysis on webhook events (36% of recurring dollars, June 2026). Dollars = prod user_payments + Close; Stripe-integration Mixpanel dollars usable for Stripe engine only, pending Q28.
Never mix Mixpanel namespaces in one KPI ('Login' vs user_logged_in, 'Signup' vs signup, 'Influencer Search' vs influencer_discovery_search 41% apart - Q25).
Exclude user_created_by_admin accounts from funnels; roll team members up via main_user_id; calendar-day windows.

Event birth dates: cancel_trial 2026-04-22; trial_* friction family 2026-06-30. created_list has NO emitter in the repo (R16 unmerged) - treat any created_list rows as evidence of an out-of-band patch. Trends crossing those dates are measurement changes.

NEW measurement changes on 2026-07-21 deploys: (a) trial search counting now uses a search-session window (SEARCH_COUNT_WINDOW_SECONDS; code default 50s, comment claims 300s) - counted trial searches < raw searches from that date; (b) the proxy stopped incrementing subscription counts for trial-gated searches (backend consumeSearchQuota is authoritative); (c) IMAI signups skip onboarding entirely - finished_onboarding / successful_onboarding_completed volumes collapse, and Gmail signups (via Google) are allowed again, shifting the email-domain mix. influencer_discovery_search webhook events still fire per API call and are NOT affected by the window.
payment_failed is dunning noise - count DISTINCT users.
created_campaign AND campaign_created both fire on create (campaigns.controller.ts:339/:356, re-verified at HEAD - Q9) - dedupe.
amount fields are WHOLE USD; IL-billed x1.17 VAT on some paths; Close deal values are cents.
Three things are called 'pixel': customer conversion SDK (sdk/pixel.js -> /tracking/*), legacy AWS visit pixel (t.imai.co), and the logs DB nickname. Do not conflate.
Event delivery is best-effort by design (no retry/queue) - expect gaps downstream.
The proxy and backend/main use DIFFERENT prod conventions ('production' vs 'prod') - check before adding env gates. The proxy emitter has NO gate at all at HEAD.
trial_analytics_report.cancel_date counts any %cancel% event incl. started_cancellation_process - do not trust it for churn.
